name: Manastorm: the Blackfathom Deeps Lorgus Jett stage loads its objective at stage start (#11677)
contract: Player report (#11677): the depth 20 Blackfathom Deeps stage showed "Defeat: Lorgus Jett", but Lorgus never
appeared. PR #7073 removed his stock spawn 26173 near the end of the stage route, so his only spawn is now
9780127 in the Twilight hall, about 255 yards from the arrival point 2155. A private stage loads a grid only
when a player comes near it, so the objective did not exist until a player wandered close to that hall.
Segments 73 (normal) and 240 (endgame) now load the objective's own native spawn when the stage starts, as the
Meshlok and Ragglesnout stages do. The player stays at the arrival point: Lorgus (12902) must exist on the map
within ten seconds although he is more than 60 yards away.

steps.label: The player entered the private Blackfathom Deeps stage
SETUP: the stage is Blackfathom Deeps
CONTROL: Lorgus Jett is not within 60 yards of the arrival point
Lorgus Jett is loaded on the stage map without the player moving
